note: Captured in process with the planner available and no database, so each hospital's records are in memory, loaded from apps/healthcare-demo/data/ist/. The per-client limits and hourly caps are off, except model approvals, which are limited to 2 per minute so the last approval example shows a 429. No framework service was running, so the status example lists each one as unavailable. The framework service addresses point at port 9, where nothing listens, so the answers are the same on a machine that runs the services.

condition.intended_use: Flag patients with suspected acute stroke who are at high risk of death or dependency at six months, so a specialist reviews them first. Decision support only: it does not diagnose stroke, does not choose treatment, and does not remove any case from the normal work queue. A clinician reviews every r…
limitations: The records are real, de-identified patient records from the International Stroke Trial, recruited in 1991-1996. Stroke care has changed since then, so outcomes today differ.

The trial enrolled patients with a clinical diagnosis of acute ischaemic stroke within 48 hours of onset and no clear reason for or against aspirin or heparin. That is a narrower group than everyone seen with a suspected stroke.
The seed rule's points were chosen by hand as an illustration. They were not fitted or validated.
